benchmark.name: MedQA-USMLE

testSnapshot.answerNormalization: MIRAGE scorer maps the answer label A-D to its corresponding option index; the raw MedQA mirror uses answer_idx. Inference receives only question and options.

benchmark.testGoldBoundary: The test files were used only to check count, field schema, file hash, option-label set, question/options order hash, and parity between the pinned snapshots. Gold values were not printed, used for tuning, or passed to a model. Inference must consume a question/options-only projection. Scoring is permitted only after predictions and execution/configuration hashes are frozen.

validation.frozenSubsetSelection: Python random.Random(42).sample(range(1272), 100), sorted by source row order; IDs are source row index plus SHA-256 of canonical question/options only.
validation.originalPaperSelectionReason: The paper reports a 100-example validation tuning set but does not publish its IDs/order or random seed.

publishedReference.paper: Xiong et al., Improving Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Medicine with Iterative Follow-up Questions, arXiv:2408.00727v3
publishedReference.scopeNote: These values are for the paper Llama setup. The user selected local Qwen3-8B for HC-RAG-002; paper numbers are background only and are not a Qwen acceptance gate.

paperParityModel.evidence: The paper model identity remains documented for historical reference only. The user explicitly selected the already-present local Qwen3-8B; HC-RAG-002 will not run or claim the Llama paper setup.

corpusAndRetriever.sourceSnapshotStatus: Full Textbooks + current NCBI StatPearls MedText was prepared offline from the pinned Textbooks revision and the official NCBI rolling archive. The rolling StatPearls content has revision=null and is identified by its archive SHA-256 and measured retrieval timestamp. Current counts differ from the historical README: 125847 Textbooks chunks and 384050 StatPearls chunks. The full MedCPT IndexFlatIP files are stored outside Git and verified by corpus-manifest.json.

parameterAudit.paperProtocol: The paper tuned i-MedRAG parameters on 100 validation samples. The exact Llama experiment configuration is not recovered. Because this run uses the user-selected local Qwen3-8B, it is scoped to A/B/C implementation parity and does not claim to reproduce the paper tuning protocol or its absolute accuracy.
parameterAudit.nextAction: Restart the local Qwen endpoint with the frozen chat-template default, confirm a completed DSH no-tool turn and native tool call, then enable the existing shared health-engine benchmark route for single/iterative and empty-result live cases.

localQwenParityProtocol.status: declared local-Qwen parity bootstrap; these are not claimed as the paper-tuned parameters
localQwenParityProtocol.reason: A real DSH CoT smoke exhausted 1,024 and 2,048 output tokens under the Qwen3 default hidden-thinking mode; a request-level vLLM check with enable_thinking=false completed within 285 output tokens. This is a declared shared serving setting for A/B/C, not a prompt change.

dshToolChoiceAudit.evidence: At DSH 5badb150, GenerateOptions supports tools but has no tool_choice/toolChoice field; the pi-ai and DeepSeek adapters document tool_choice as unmapped.
dshToolChoiceAudit.allowedBenchmarkBehavior: Use a benchmark system instruction requesting exactly one research tool call; zero or more-than-one outer calls are execution failures. Do not patch or vendor DSH and do not implement a second loop.
